statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to optimize rate control management
The associated diagnoses include Z86.73 and I49.5
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
